=== a frame
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.text
	.globl f
f:
	.loc 1 3 0
	.cfi_startproc
	mov.l r14, @-r15
	.cfi_def_cfa_offset 4
	.cfi_offset r14, -4
	sts.l pr, @-r15
	.cfi_def_cfa_offset 8
	.cfi_offset pr, -8
	mov r15, r14
	.cfi_def_cfa_register r14
	.loc 1 4 5 prologue_end
	.cfi_offset fr12, -12
	.cfi_offset gbr, -16
	.cfi_offset mach, -20
	.cfi_offset macl, -24
	.cfi_offset fpul, -28
	mov #0, r0
	.loc 1 5 1 epilogue_begin
	mov r14, r15
	lds.l @r15+, pr
	mov.l @r15+, r14
	.cfi_def_cfa r15, 0
	rts
	nop
	.cfi_endproc
=== an alignment the section ends with
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.text
f:
	.loc 1 3 0
	mov #1, r0
	.loc 1 4 0
	rts
	nop
	.p2align 3
